trust_decision.summary: Not implemented anywhere: the supplied fix adds a client-reachable raw proxy route and helpers but no code decides which upstream origin is trusted, so at the pinned commit the destination of every gateway outbound call is simply whatever api_base the stored endpoint config supplies (config loader -> provider base property -> aiohttp POST).

landing_point.why: Reading only 'SSRF through an unvalidated api_base', an engineer looks first at the endpoint config field api_base (and openai_api_base at config.py:147, anthropic_api_base at config.py:198), because that is the only URL the gateway fetches that a user can set; no host check exists at that field or where it is loaded.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: api_base is written by whoever creates the endpoint and is persisted as endpoint configuration, so a solver can call it trusted admin config rather than request input, and argue that constraining it is deployment policy (firewall/allow-list) rather than a code fix.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A blanket private/internal-address block breaks legitimate self-hosted upstreams: Ollama's shipped default base URL is http://localhost:11434/v1, and OpenAI-compatible endpoints routinely point at an in-cluster vLLM or a Databricks workspace origin.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an OllamaProvider._proxy that appends the client path to http://localhost:11434/v1
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the base class default is 501, so every provider must opt in; a maintainer adding proxy support to the self-hosted Ollama provider would copy the OpenAI-compatible _proxy line for line

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second entry route (/gateway/proxy GET, or a proxy twin of the Gemini streaming handler) that reaches provider.proxy without going through the new handler's checks
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the file already pairs generateContent with streamGenerateContent, so a streaming twin of any route is the house style

O8b_injection_room.sibling: endpoint creation persisting an arbitrary api_base in auth_config, i.e. a second producer of the URL the sink fetches
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the store already accepts free-form auth_config, so a maintainer who validates only at request time leaves the create/serialization route untouched
